correctness.rationale: A complete proof was reconstructed. From a Ritt power one gets power boundedness of T and root-of-unity peripheral spectrum. Necessity is spectral mapping. For sufficiency, with S=T^d and a=N/d, the nontrivial a-th roots are excluded from the spectrum of S, so Q_a(S) is invertible; the factorization I-S^a=(I-S)Q_a(S) transfers the discrete Ritt derivative estimate from S^a to S. Positive powers of a Ritt operator are then controlled by telescoping the one-step derivative. Boundary cases a=1 and empty peripheral spectrum are included.
